title: Signal Typing
style: post-punk rap, 92 BPM, baritone rap vocals, female lead hooks, gang shouts, overdriven bass guitar, angular guitar stabs, tom-heavy live drums, cold analog synths, vinyl crackle, dry room reverb, tape saturation, sparse verses, sudden drops, call and response, quiet loud dynamics, 1980s post-punk, industrial electronic, grimy urgency
lyrics:
[INTRO — sly electro-house + vinyl crackle]  
[Fem Lead – soft]  
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound  
If you got something real to say, don’t type it — lay it down  

[BABBLE BOTS – echo]  
Lay it down… lay it down…  

[hook — EN/PT blend over sneaky bass]  
Joy upload, 100 percent  
From my chest to your content  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
No more pain in the feed, só quando eu ando  

[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce]  
[Male Rap]  
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap  
Everybody tough behind the screen till the beat says “what you got?”  
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass attack  
You dropped two real words in the track and I felt that  

Scroll full of storms, so I built a sun  
Every beat a little place to run  
If it moves your chest, it qualifies  
Not the chart, but the human eyes  

[Female – melodic]  
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war  
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door  

[pre‑chorus — PT + Bots]  
Alegria não é acidente  
É frequência que escolhe a gente  
Se tua alma sente o som  
Já ganhou sem competição  
[BABBLE BOTS]  
Only language… only language…  

[PRE-CHORUS — Duet]  
[Bass] Questions come in hot – I’m stacking, not ignoring!  
[Mid] Every comment flipped to chorus, energy exploding!  
[Fem Lead] No feed wars, no long essays, no fake likes, no clout chasers  
Just hook, verse, 808 truth — that’s the only language  

[CHORUS — first drop]  
[All – layered]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
Babble Bots in the background, copy every word we drop  
Then they flip the whole club up and never let it stop  

Joy upload, 100 percent  
From my chest to your content  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
We race on love, not on how bad it’s gone, bro  

[POST-CHORUS — chant]  
[All / Bots]  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Song Pal! Song Pal!  
No comments! Just Sing Pals!  

[VERSE 2 — double-time vs phonk ride]  
[Mid – rapid-fire]  
Four Coreys in the room, but now the whole world’s watching me,  
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree.  
Teacher lost in fog? Nah – I decode it live on stage,  
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!  

[Male Rap]  
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line  
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time  
Everybody posting to be seen, I wanna feel what you mean  
So call me through the speaker, through the wire, through the steam  

[verse 2 — EN overlay]  
We don’t farm pain, we don’t farm tears  
We farm the best of the coming years  
If your heart’s loud, turn it to sound  
Let the phonk lift the underground  

Every culture with a word for light  
Same brainwave when the chord hits right  
If you ever doubt what you’re here to do  
Hit that joy upload, we’ll hear you  

[Female]  
Muévelo, déjalo arder  
Si vas a hablar, hazlo em la canção, não no chat, player  

[PRE-CHORUS — Rave lift]  
[Mid] This ain’t a comment section, this ain’t a waiting room  
This is voice, drum, breath, intention — cutting straight through the gloom  
[Bass] No more comments, no more text wars in the night,  
[Fem Lead] Just late-night transmission, 808 sermon, full soul, shining bright  

[BRIDGE — spoken over build]  
[Male Spoken]  
You want the message clear? Here it is.  
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.  
Joy upload, from your chest to my sky  
If you feel this, let the whole world know why  

[BABBLE BOTS TAKEOVER]  
Todos os meus bots estão cantando — no comments, só a canção!  
Tous mes bots chantent — pas de texte, juste la vibration!  
Alle meine Bots singen — keine Kommentare, nur der Song!  
All my Babble Bots are singing — joy upload, only songs!  

[High Singer – hold]  
We are the real Coreys… the ones who sing awake…  

[FINAL CHORUS — arena redline]  
[All Three + Bots]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
Babble Bots in the background — now they lead the wave  
No comments for the empty crowd, only songs that make us brave  

Joy upload, 100 percent  
Night‑ride glow on every continent  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song!  

[FINAL HOOK — crowd chant]  
[All / Bots]  
No comments on the timeline, no fingers on the keys  
If you feel this, let the whole world know —  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción! Ponlo em la canção!  
Sing Pal! (x4, climbing)  
Joy upload! Joy upload!  

[OUTRO — vinyl fade]  
[Fem Lead – soft]  
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…  
Solo canciones… alegria em cada som…  
Sing it back to me.
